goal: Shrink Darwin release binaries by ~4-5% by enabling identical code folding in the guix build
Benefits maintainers and users via smaller bitcoind and bitcoin-qt distribution size
reviewability: Ready to review, no CI failure or rebase need reported
But an unresolved correctness question means the current flags may still change, read the thread first
agreement: Unaddressed objection: safe ICF can fold address-taken functions like --icf=all without -faddrsig, demonstrated on the real binary (151henry151)
Independently corroborated with a synthetic function-pointer-identity bug example (Sjors)
Concept support for ICF in general, plus a note on probe ordering (hebasto)
Author engaging but has not changed the code, instead pursuing an upstream LLVM docs PR (fanquake)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because the size win is real and guix-reproducible across several independent builders
But there is an open release-integrity question about the safe ICF flag folding address-taken functions incorrectly
This is treated as a genuine could-ship-a-wrong-binary risk, an open decision rather than a resolved nit
